B.reason: Staggered dual momentum at a 9% target has the strongest growth case and a natural daily-trading structure, but top-5 selection with a slow 126-day absolute filter and a 4%/day cap leaves it exposed to V-shaped crashes and concentration in overlapping sleeve picks, and how a whole-portfolio vol target is applied across independently rebalanced sleeves is unclear.

E.reason: Maximum diversification with a turbulence overlay is the most genuinely diversified core and has a cheap predictive first test, but the minimum-trade-day guarantee is only asserted, there is no vol target, and a bond-heavy core that flees to Treasuries and TIPS in stress is precisely wrong in a 2022-type inflationary sell-off.
